Part_Guideline: Questions 19-24. For each question, choose the correct answer.
Passage:
Penguins
Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly. They live mostly in the very cold parts of the world. They use their wings (19) ........ swim in the ocean. They can swim very fast to catch fish. When they are on land, they walk slowly or slide on their stomachs. Penguins are black and white, which helps them hide from dangerous animals in the sea. They like to stay together in large groups (20) ........ this keeps them warm. Male and female penguins work together to take care of (21) ........ babies.
Question: Select the correct word for space (19).
Explanation: Dùng 'to' + động từ nguyên thể để chỉ mục đích: 'use their wings to swim' (sử dụng cánh để bơi).

Part_Guideline: Question 31
Passage:
Read the email from your English friend, Sam.

'I want to buy a new computer game. Which game should I buy? Where can I buy it? Do you want to play it with me this weekend?'

Write an email to Sam and answer the questions.
Write 25 words or more.
Answer:
Hi Sam,
You should buy 'Super Racing 3'. It's really fun! You can buy it at the game shop in the mall. Yes, I would love to play it with you on Saturday!
See you,
[Your Name]
Explanation: Thí sinh cần trả lời đủ 3 câu hỏi: Gợi ý tên game, chỉ địa điểm mua, và đồng ý chơi cùng vào cuối tuần. Viết trên 25 từ.
